collections.name: The Christmas Collection
collections.intro: Some Christmases are worth keeping. A first one together. A first one as a family. The year the stockings had a new name on them.
collections.intro2: The Christmas Collection turns those moments into keepsakes you bring out every December: pearl-filled baubles, a gold mirror disc and natural wood signs, each personalised by hand in London.
